name: VPS and dev boxes
ownerWords: stop being paranoid in plan under p45, p221. these should be modeled separately, like in a doc tracking all the known vps infra risks and a duty that checks these. ... things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved -> cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: No risk on the infra risk page (wiki domains/ops/infra-risks, its list in duties/01a11af8-962e-773d-a19a-ee4104011987/infra-risks.json) has a Grafana alert rule firing, us-metal01's root disk has at least 30 days left at the last 24 h rate, all 9 M1 Air runners are online, and no Grafana alert rule routed to this chat fires, each one that does held by the alert bridge's triage job. Tell the owner only when a risk fires with no fix moving it.

metrics.label: Risks on the infra risk page with a Grafana rule firing
Days until us-metal01's root disk is full at the last 24 h rate
Grafana alert rules firing for this chat

onMiss: Fix a source_error first; a gap line means the risk page names a rule Grafana lacks, so fix the page's list or the rule. Each firing line names the risk page line and its owner. For each one add one fix step with duty "<dutyId>/risks_firing" naming that risk, and steer the owner's live job on it, or start one job with rlm.create_session that lands a code change for it (commit.mjs --object-only --push-ci ci/<name> in auto-sns-agent, or a sieun-pi commit), and set the step's duty, job and sessionId. A risk owned by another thread gets the ask once with the page line, and this chat's fix step tracks its land. root_disk_days under 30: the fix step goes to metal's disk plan (ClickHouse hot/cold to /hdd.raid10, cold PG tables to an HDD tablespace). air_runners_online under 9: read devbox_runner_up by name on obs.virev.ai and bring the missing runner back on the M1 Air. An unchecked line is a risk with no rule; give it a rule through the Grafana alert code. alerts_firing over 0: Each alert_firing line is a Grafana rule that fires now for this chat and the triage job the alert bridge gave it. Steer that job with scripts/job-steer.ts when it ended or went quiet, naming the rule and how long it has fired, and start one job with rlm.create_session for a line with no triage job. Keep the one fix step this metric gets, with the job of the oldest firing rule as its job, and put no step per alert on the plan. A rule that fires on something that is not a fault gets fixed or deleted in grafana/alerting. A source_error means alert-bridge.json could not be read. Tell the owner which risks fire and what fixes them. All on target: no message.
